name: The Ritz-Carlton, Chengdu
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel overlooking Tianfu Square in central Chengdu, with a full-floor spa and Cantonese and Sichuanese dining at Li Xuan
best_for: Travelers who want a central Chengdu base overlooking Tianfu Square
Guests who want Sichuanese dining and a spa on site

facts.text: Guest rooms are on the 28th to the 41st floors.
FLAIR serves Asian-inspired tapas indoors and on an outdoor patio.
SPICES is the all-day dining restaurant, with live-action cooking stations serving international-style dishes.
The Dining Room serves Mediterranean dishes.
The indoor swimming pool has an underwater music system.
The spa uses Valmont products and locally sourced teas in its treatments.
Complimentary parking is offered to in-house guests.
Club level offers a dedicated concierge, a private Club Lounge and in-room amenities.
The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding is among the attractions near the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel stands on the site of what was once an imperial palace.
A Kongfu tea performance takes place daily in the 25th-floor hotel lobby.
The hotel overlooks Tianfu Square in central Chengdu.
The spa occupies a full floor of the hotel.
Li Xuan Chinese Restaurant specializes in Cantonese and local Sichuanese dishes.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
The minimum age for access and treatments at the spa is 16.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not give complimentary access to Club.
